description: F2 corrected concurrent-load cabinet reference result, re-expressed on the conservative interval-aware estimand used by the frozen Experiment 2 challenge

estimand.note: This is the SAME conservative interval-aware estimand used in the frozen Experiment 2 challenge (challenge_analysis.json). The f2_primary_result.json previously used the non-conservative C_lower(FP) - C_lower(Random) formula.

comparison_with_non_conservative.note: A/I/B counts are identical under both estimands because FP C_lower exceeds Random C_upper in all 25 scenarios. The difference in median is small (0.28 pp) because FP bracket widths are narrow (median ~0.19 pp) and Random C_lower vs C_upper spread is modest.

comparison_with_frozen_challenge_F1.note: Both F1 (job-contribution reference) and F2 (concurrent-load reference) support FP over Random at r=1.25. F2 result is stronger and uses the same conservative estimand as the frozen challenge.
